$comment: DAP (adhesives, sealants and caulks, Rust-Oleum brand) runs a Sitecore site with server-rendered product pages under /products/<category>/<product>. Product pages have the name (h1) and a meta description, but the variant table (SKU, unit size, colour) and the product image are rendered by the page's scripts in a way the selectors cannot read, and there is no price (DAP sells through retailers), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning. fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns the variant rows as specs (8 on the sample: SKU, unit size, colour) and the product image, each checked against the page, at 1,789+1,577 tokens. The selectors are the http fallback and the saved fixture (title and description only). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description; browser: the same, slower; ai-crawler-avalai: the same plus 8 specs and the image; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex, yahoo and brave were not needed for this site's data. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) Weldwood Landau Top and Trim 1145 page on 2026-11-19.
